h1: Rattanachol Hotel — a 4-star city hotel in central Chonburi that's easy to reach and good value
intro: If you're coming for business, a meeting, an event, or just an overnight stop in central Chonburi before heading on to Pattaya or Rayong, a hotel that's "right on the main road, easy to reach, and not expensive" is something you don't find often around here — Rattanachol Hotel is a 4-star city hotel on Sukhumvit Road in the Bang Pla Soi area, in the heart of Mueang Chonburi, near Chonburi Bay and CentralPlaza Chonburi · it was renovated and reopened in April 2018, with spacious rooms from 30 to 55 sqm · what a lot of people mention is the outdoor saltwater pool, sauna, gym, Chinese and Thai-international restaurants, and a lobby bar with live music in the evening, plus free parking · from about ฿1,500/night, rated 8.2 from 65 reviews on Trip.com and 4.3/5 on TripAdvisor, ranked #4 of 46 hotels in Chonburi.

body.html: When it comes to where to stay in Chonburi province, most people think first of the beachfront resorts at Bang Saen or the holiday hotels in Pattaya, and forget that "downtown Chonburi" itself is a district with people coming and going all year round — people handling government paperwork, doing business, visiting relatives at Chonburi Hospital, or stopping over for a night on the drive down to the eastern provinces · Rattanachol Hotel is exactly the kind of hotel this group needs, because it's a large 4-star city hotel sitting on Sukhumvit Road in the Bang Pla Soi area, in the heart of Mueang Chonburi · the building has a long history as one of the town's older hotels before it went through a major renovation and reopened in April 2018, which made the rooms and common areas look much newer and more modern than their old reputation · the hotel's position is clear: it's a city hotel that focuses on convenience, location, and value rather than being a beachfront resort that puts you to sleep to the sound of the waves.

Before getting into the details, let me be straight with you: this review is put together from real guest reviews across several platforms — Trip.com, Agoda, Booking.com, TripAdvisor and Wongnai — along with information the hotel publishes itself. I didn't stay here myself and then write it up · the overall picture is "a large, complete, good-value city hotel" that gets consistent praise for cleanliness and how well you sleep · its Trip.com score sits at 8.2 out of 10 from 65 reviews, while TripAdvisor gives it 4.3 out of 5 and ranks it #4 of 46 hotels in Chonburi, with a Travelers' Choice award · what's interesting in the TripAdvisor sub-scores is that the highest-rated category is Sleep Quality at about 4.7, followed by cleanliness at around 4.4 and service at around 4.2 · the lower-scoring categories are value and location, which reflects that the strength here is "sleeping comfortably and cleanly," while location and price come down to what you're here for.

The big picture and who it suits — Rattanachol Hotel suits best people who have things to do in downtown Chonburi and want a well-equipped hotel at a reasonable price · the first group is business travelers coming for meetings or work in town, since there are meeting rooms, banquet rooms and a business center on site · the second is people hosting a banquet, a wedding, or a seminar, because the hotel has a large ballroom and is a venue Chonburi locals know well · the third is people visiting relatives at Chonburi Hospital or handling government business in town who want somewhere close and easy to reach · the fourth is travelers driving along Sukhumvit Road who want an overnight stop in the city center before continuing to Pattaya, Rayong, Chanthaburi, or the islands · and one more group is families who want a hotel with a pool and parking on a budget they can manage · on the flip side, if you're set on a beach trip where you can walk straight onto the sand, or you're looking for a quiet resort atmosphere to unwind, this might not be the right fit, because it's a city hotel right on a main road, not on the beach · setting your expectations correctly from the start clearly makes a big difference to how happy you'll be here.

Location and getting around is something to understand correctly from the start · the hotel sits at 678/17 Sukhumvit Road, Bang Pla Soi, Mueang Chonburi, an old area in the heart of Chonburi town right by Chonburi Bay · the upside of this location is that it's on a main road that's easy to reach, easy to drive to, and within close range of almost everything in town — Wat Thep Phuttharam and the neighborhood temples are about 200–400 meters away, Chonburi Hospital is about a 2 min drive, the Bang Sai bridge and the Chonburi old market are nearby, and CentralPlaza Chonburi is about 5–6 km away, or roughly a 10–15 min drive · Bang Saen beach, the popular seaside spot, is about 15 km away, a 20–25 min drive · if you're driving from Bangkok, it's about an hour and a half via the motorway or Sukhumvit Road, and the hotel has free private parking with valet service on site, which helps a lot in a city area where parking is hard to find · one honest note: because it's right on Sukhumvit Road in the city center, rooms facing the street may pick up some traffic noise, and the surroundings are a busy urban area rather than an open sea view like a resort, even though some upper-floor rooms can see the city skyline and Chonburi Bay.

"Easy to stay when you've got business in town — easy to drive to, has parking, the room is clean and comfortable to sleep in. In the evening you can come down to the lobby bar where there's live music, and it's cheaper than other hotels around here at a similar level."

Room types and decor — Rattanachol Hotel is a large property with about 150 rooms in total, split into several tiers to choose from depending on your budget and party size · it starts with the 30 sqm Superior Room, available with either a king bed or two single beds (Superior Twin), good for a couple or work colleagues · stepping up is the 35 sqm Deluxe Room, which is roomier and better appointed · and the largest is the 55 sqm One Bedroom King Suite, with a separate sitting area, good for longer stays or anyone who wants extra comfort, and some suites have a jacuzzi · with rooms starting at 30 sqm, this is more spacious than many city hotels in the same price range · after the 2018 renovation the decor is contemporary in bright tones, and many reviews agree that the rooms are clean, spacious, get good natural light, and the bathrooms are roomy · the most praised point, and a genuine strength, is sleep quality — the bed and mattress are soft and comfortable and the rooms are quiet enough for a deep sleep, which is why it's the top-rated category on TripAdvisor · there's free high-speed Wi-Fi, good for anyone who has to work or join online meetings in the room · one honest note from the reviews: some basic amenities like a toothbrush or slippers aren't always provided in full, and a few older reviews mention inconsistent room condition or bed linens, so it's worth choosing a renovated room and checking the room's condition at check-in.

Facilities and the pool — for a city hotel, Rattanachol delivers a full set of facilities in the 4-star mold · the highlight is the outdoor saltwater pool, which doesn't sting the eyes the way a chlorine pool does, with a sun deck beside it, good for a cooling dip or for the kids to splash around · there's a sauna and gym for anyone who wants to relax or work out during their stay · on the events side, the hotel has meeting rooms, banquet rooms and a large ballroom, which is what makes it a popular venue for weddings, seminars and banquets among Chonburi locals · there's a business center, currency exchange, laundry service (at an extra charge), luggage storage, room service, and a 24-hour reception · free private parking with valet, and free Wi-Fi in the common areas · one thing to know from the reviews is that the pool isn't large, better for a dip and a splash than for serious lap swimming, and at times it may be used for children's swimming classes, so if you're coming specifically to use the pool it's worth asking the hotel first whether it's open to general guests as usual during your stay.

Food and restaurants — food is something Rattanachol does well and is remembered for among locals · the hotel has two main dining areas: the Chinese restaurant (Peal Chinese Restaurant), which serves Chinese food that many reviews praise as tasty with a capable kitchen, and a Thai-international restaurant for everyday meals · what reviews mention often is the evening atmosphere at the lobby bar, which has live music in the evening, making it an easy place to sip a drink and listen to music, plus a late-evening rice-porridge buffet with à la carte options to choose from · breakfast is an American and Asian buffet served in the morning; some reviews say the breakfast selection isn't very wide but a few items like the rice porridge are good · in-hotel food prices are reasonable, as many reviews note · on top of that, the city-center location helps a lot with eating, because the surroundings are an old town with restaurants, cafés, well-known food spots and markets to walk or take a short drive to anytime, including seafood and local Chonburi dishes · for anyone who wants an easy bite near the hotel, having restaurants all around within close range is one of the advantages of staying in the city center.

Service is another category that gets fairly consistent praise in the real reviews, sitting at around 4.2 out of 5 on TripAdvisor · several staff are mentioned as friendly, approachable, able to speak English, and helpful, and there are reviews praising the welcome drink at check-in and attentive care of guests · the reception is open 24 hours and offers luggage storage, which helps a lot when guests arrive before check-in time or have to move on after check-out · but to be fair, some voices in the reviews note that the attentiveness and speed of some staff at certain times isn't entirely consistent, especially on the night shift, which is something you find in large hotels with multiple shifts · overall, service is still in good shape and is part of what brings regulars back, especially locals who come to host events or stay often.

Voices from real reviews (both praise and criticism) — gathered from Trip.com, Agoda, Booking.com, TripAdvisor and Wongnai, and the picture that emerges is fairly consistent · On the praise side: the rooms are clean and more spacious than the price suggests, sleep quality is very good with soft beds and easy sleep (the top-rated category), the city-center location is convenient and easy to drive to, there's free parking, the Chinese food is tasty and the lobby bar has live music with a nice atmosphere, the staff are approachable and speak English, and it's good value compared with other 4-star hotels in the same area · On the criticism side: what comes up is that some basic amenities like a toothbrush and slippers may not always be complete, the breakfast selection is fairly limited, the pool is small and at times has children's swimming classes, the air-conditioning in some rooms blows too directly onto the bed, the speed of staff on some shifts is inconsistent, and a few older reviews mention room condition or a sofa with a musty smell and untidy bed linens · most of these gripes are details that can be solved by choosing a renovated room and asking ahead, rather than big problems that keep people from coming back, and the overall score of 8.2 and the #4 ranking in Chonburi reflect that the picture is still positive.

"The room was clean and spacious, very comfortable to sleep in, the staff were friendly, and there are Chinese and Thai restaurants with live music in the evening · one small gripe is that the bathroom amenities weren't complete and I had to ask for more, but overall it's good value."

Price comparison and value — the starting price for a Superior room is about ฿1,500/night at normal rates (several platforms show a starting rate of around 46 US dollars), rising for the Deluxe and One Bedroom Suite, which run from around ฿2,500 up depending on size and season · compared with other 4-star hotels in Chonburi and the beachfront properties that cost far more, Rattanachol feels good value in the well-equipped city-hotel group, because you get spacious rooms starting at 30 sqm, the praised sleep quality, a pool, gym, sauna, several restaurants, and free parking, at a lighter price than chain hotels of the same level · the best value is for people who have things to do in downtown Chonburi and want a complete hotel close to where they're going, or people hosting a banquet or seminar who want rooms in the same place · for anyone stopping over on a journey, this price is still reasonable for what you get · the one caveat is that if you weight sea views and a resort atmosphere over practicality, the value drops from that angle, because this place sells a city-center location and completeness, not a beach view.

Good to know before booking — there are several things that help make the stay smoother · one, if you're sensitive to traffic noise, ask for an upper-floor room or one that doesn't face directly onto Sukhumvit Road, since the hotel is right on a main road, and some upper-floor rooms also get city and Chonburi Bay views as a bonus · two, choose a renovated room and check its condition at check-in, since it's an older building only refurbished in 2018, so rooms in different sections may not all be the same · three, some basic amenities may not be provided in full, so if you need them, bring your own toothbrush or slippers or ask for more at the desk · four, if you're coming specifically to use the pool, check with the hotel first whether it's open to general guests as usual during your stay or has children's swimming classes · five, if you're hosting a banquet or seminar, the hotel has a ballroom and event services, so it's worth contacting them about packages in advance · six, check-in is from 2:00 PM, check-out before 12:00 PM, the desk is open 24 hours with luggage storage, and a deposit is charged per the hotel's policy · seven, the hotel's contact number is 038-275602 to 6 if you'd like to ask about room, pool or event details before booking.

In summary — Rattanachol Hotel isn't a luxury beachfront resort, and it doesn't try to be one · it's a large, complete, good-value 4-star city hotel on Sukhumvit Road in the heart of Chonburi town, best suited to people with business in town, business travelers, people hosting banquets and seminars, those visiting relatives at Chonburi Hospital, and people stopping over in the city center before continuing east · its strengths are spacious, clean rooms and the top-rated sleep quality, a full set of facilities — saltwater pool, gym, sauna, Chinese and Thai restaurants, a live-music lobby bar, free parking — at a price that starts at only about fifteen hundred a night · the points to set expectations around are the basic amenities that may not be complete, the small pool, street noise in road-facing rooms, and an urban-district setting rather than a beach view · if your brief is somewhere clean, comfortable to sleep in, well-equipped, and close to what you need to reach in downtown Chonburi, more than a seaside getaway atmosphere, Rattanachol Hotel is one of the most well-rounded and best-value city options in the area, and the reason it keeps holding a top spot among Chonburi hotels.

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — Rattanachol Hotel, Chonburi

faq.q: Where is Rattanachol Hotel · what's nearby?
faq.a: It's located at 678/17 Sukhumvit Road, Bang Pla Soi, Mueang Chonburi, Chonburi, in the heart of Chonburi town by Chonburi Bay · neighborhood temples are about 200–400 meters away, Chonburi Hospital is about a 2 min drive, CentralPlaza Chonburi is about 5–6 km, and Bang Saen beach is about 15 km (20–25 min drive) · it's easy to drive to since it's on a main road.

faq.q: What's the starting price at Rattanachol Hotel · what room types are there?
faq.a: Prices start at about ฿1,500/night for a 30 sqm Superior room at normal rates · there's a 35 sqm Deluxe and a 55 sqm One Bedroom King Suite (some rooms have a jacuzzi) from around ฿1,900–2,500 up · prices move with the season and demand, so always compare across several platforms before booking.

faq.q: Who is it best suited to?
faq.a: It suits very well people with business in downtown Chonburi, business travelers, those hosting banquets and seminars, people visiting relatives at Chonburi Hospital, and people stopping over in the city center before continuing east · spacious, clean rooms, comfortable to sleep in, well-equipped, with free parking · it's less suited to people set on a beach trip where you walk onto the sand, or looking for a quiet resort atmosphere.

faq.q: Does Rattanachol Hotel have a sea view · is it on the beach?
faq.a: It's a city hotel on Sukhumvit Road, not a beachfront resort · it's in the heart of Chonburi town near Chonburi Bay, and some upper-floor rooms can see city and bay views, but you can't walk onto the beach · if you want a beach trip, Bang Saen beach is about 15 km away, a 20–25 min drive.

faq.q: Is there a pool, gym, and restaurant?
faq.a: Yes to all · an outdoor saltwater pool (not large), sauna, gym, the Peal Chinese Restaurant, a Thai-international restaurant, and a lobby bar with live music in the evening · breakfast is an American-Asian buffet · if you're coming specifically to use the pool, check first whether it has children's swimming classes during your visit.

faq.q: Can Rattanachol Hotel host banquets and seminars?
faq.a: Yes · the hotel has a large ballroom, banquet rooms, meeting rooms, and a business center, and it's a venue Chonburi locals favor for weddings, seminars and banquets · it also offers wedding services · we recommend contacting them about packages and room capacity in advance at 038-275602 to 6.
